limitations: Immediate hazard and having so yielded remain unresolved; no speed, distance, stop, passage-order or contact-free surrogate.
Intention, perception, lawful progression and regulatory qualification are not established by simulator motion.
Signaling qualification requires independent sourced/authored context and actual recorded device histories.
Finite samples do not establish intersample behavior.

Finite stream-phase comparison: initial and further opposing starting positions translate together at a fixed30m initial-to-further offset. This does not isolate the causal effect of moving only the initial vehicle.
35s chosen because far30s retained a counterpart without completed crossing; far35s has complete outcomes and final stopped observation.
Approved device type and business district are external authored assumptions, distinct from native behavior and physical flashing.
Core/source timestamp, body/control/trajectory and primary/source video pixels require separate saved-only acceptance.
